question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**tunnel**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most suitable word to fill in the fifth blank would be "**tunnel**."
 
• The phrase* "the light at the end of the tunnel"* is an idiomatic expression used to symbolize hope or relief after a difficult or challenging period. It implies that** even during tough times, there's a glimpse of hope or a positive outcome ahead.**
 
• In the context of the sentence, this phrase signifies that amidst the suffering caused by the lockdowns, the few success stories represent a source of hope or positivity, similar to the light one sees at the end of a tunnel after going through a dark or challenging passage.

 

Correct Usage:__ *Amidst all the chaos and suffering caused by the pandemic, there are some positive stories of grit, persistence, and bravado. Some businesses understood the needs of the times to make huge profits. Businesses diversified and were successful. Although there are numerous stories of people and business owners suffering due to lockdowns, this small percentage of success stories is like the light at the end of the **tunnel.*** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Kernel**: In a general sense, a kernel refers to the core or central part of something. It can also mean the innermost and essential part of a seed, fruit, or nut. Figuratively, it represents the essential or crucial part of an idea, concept, or matter. *For instance, "The **kernel** of the issue lies in miscommunication," or "The kernel of a popcorn is the part that pops into the fluffy snack we enjoy."*
 
• **Hill**: A hill is a raised area of land that is higher than the surrounding areas but smaller than a mountain. It has a defined elevation and can be used for various purposes such as agriculture, recreation, or residential areas.* For example, "They hiked to the top of the **hill** for a scenic view," or "The town was nestled in the foothills of the mountains."*
 
• **Rope**: A rope is a thick cord or bundle of fibers twisted or braided together, typically used for various purposes like tying, lifting, or securing objects. Ropes come in different materials and sizes, serving different functions based on their strength and durability. *For instance, "They used a **rope** to secure the boat to the dock," or "She tied the boxes together with a sturdy rope." *
